text: 上交所数据显示，2026年9月A股新开户191.19万户，环比下降20.25%，同比2025年9月的293.72万户下降34.91%。 2026年累计新开2712.6万户，同比增长34.63%。
text_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange data shows that 1.9119 million new A-share accounts were opened in September 2026, down 20.25% month on month and down 34.91% from 2.9372 million in September 2025. A cumulative 27.126 million new accounts were opened in 2026, up 34.63% year on year.
